item.title: Five charged after suspected fentanyl seized in raid
item.description: Five people are charged after Chatham-Kent police seized suspected fentanyl in a raid earlier Wednesday. Police searched a residence on St. Clair Street and seized about 86.5 grams of suspected fentanyl, a BB gun, digital scales, packaging materials and cellphones.
